content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-419. - I.P.C. Table 704.1, Slope of horizontal drainage piping.
content.summary:
Table 704.1. Slope of horizontal drainage pipe,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"TABLE 704.1
SLOPE OF HORIZONTAL DRAINAGE PIPE
Size (inches)
Minimum slope (inch per foot)
3 or less
¼
4 to 6
⅛
8 or larger
1/16
